  main.worldmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: W
    label: World map hotkey
    help: Opens the world map at any moment. A key name rather than a scancode; 0 disables it.
  main.townmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: "Y"
    label: Town map hotkey
    help: Opens the town map at any moment. 0 or T keeps the vanilla T key.
  main.no_scope_penalty:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: No close range penalty for scoped weapons
    help: "Covers the scoped hunting rifle, and the Bozar and sniper rifle where EcCo is installed. Affected weapons are listed in the no_scope_penalty section of the ini."
  main.improved_grenades:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Improved grenades
    help: "Grenades ignore the target's armour class and can be thrown into empty hexes. Also covers flares, explosive rockets and EcCo's grenade launchers."
  main.molotov_fire:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Molotov cocktails do fire damage
    help: "Fire damage instead of explosive, with the burning death animation."
  main.max_knockback:
    kind: int
    min: -1
    unit: hexes
    sentinels:
      "-1": Unlimited (vanilla)
      "0": No knockback
    default: -1
    label: Limit knockback distance
    help: Applies to all weapons and explosives.
  main.trunk_space:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Bottomless car trunk
  main.autodoors:
    kind: choice
    options:
      - value: 0
        label: "Off"
      - value: 1
        label: Open
      - value: 2
        label: Open and close
    default: 1
    label: Automatic doors
    help: "Outside combat, walk through unlocked doors without opening them first, the way NPCs do."
  main.carry_weight:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Unlimited carry weight
    help: The Chosen One carries up to 99999 regardless of Strength.
  main.level5:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Level 5 after the Temple of Trials
    help: Grants 9500 XP on completing the temple.
  main.ammobox:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Show ammo type in combat
    help: The current ammo type is displayed in a notification box.
  main.modoc_brahmin:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Modoc brahmin on your team
    help: Stops party members wiping out the brahmin during the Modoc quest.
  main.healing_revision:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Healing revision
    help: "Reworks Doctor and First Aid - Doctor's effectiveness scales with First Aid, each is usable once a day per patient, the amount healed follows skill level, and healing applies automatically while resting and travelling."
  main.hp_over_head:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Show HP over head
    help: "In combat, for the player, party and nearby enemies. Updates can lag, and it interferes with combat floats."
  main.damage_mod:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Damage mod
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.DamageFormula
      is:
        - 0
    help: "Reworks firearm damage so DR mod multiplies DR and DT and sets the damage multiplier, which makes AP ammo worth carrying. Built for vanilla stats; mods that rebalance ammo, such as YAAM or F2WR, will not combine well."
  main.highlighting:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Expanded highlighting
    help: "Replaces sfall's own highlighting mod. Set Key=0 in the Highlighting section of sfall-mods.ini when using this."
  main.auto_reload:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Reload after combat
    help: Both weapons are reloaded once combat ends.
  main.party_level_match:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Party level match
    help: "Companions level up to match the player's experience rather than staying behind. Covers vanilla and Restoration Project companions."
  main.unlimited_party:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: No charisma limit on party size
    help: Removes the charisma check when an NPC joins. Karma and quest checks still apply.
  main.keymap:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Remap hotkeys
    help: "Applies the remapping in the keymap section of mods/fo2tweaks.ini, which by default puts quick save on F5, quick load on F8, load game on F9, and centre on the player on J."
  main.min_light_level:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    max: 100
    unit: "%"
    sentinels:
      "0": "Off"
    default: 0
    label: Minimum light level
    help: "Map light never falls below this, for Restoration Project maps dark enough to be a strain. 49 is the recommended value."
  main.speedup:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: General game speedup
    help: "Writes faster values into the game's config files - skipped movies, shorter fades, quicker equip animation. It takes effect after loading a save and relaunching, and turning it off later does not put the old values back."
  main.run_speed:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Increased run speed
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.UseFileSystemOverride
      is:
        - 1
    help: Removes the run speed penalty armour carries and lets slower companions keep up. The run_speed section chooses which of them it covers.
  main.no_drop_items_on_death:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: "Don't drop items on death"
    help: "Critters killed by the violent death animations keep their inventory, so the remains can be looted normally instead of scattering across the ground."
  main.gigolo_limit:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    sentinels:
      "0": Vanilla
    default: 0
    label: Gigolo perk threshold
    help: How many different partners the Gigolo perk takes. Vanilla grants it after 10 encounters with anyone.
  main.auto_cursor:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Automatic combat cursor
    help: The cursor switches to attack over an enemy and back to move over an empty hex.
  main.ap_rollover:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    unit: AP
    default: 2
    label: Action points carried over
    help: "Unused action points carry to the next turn, replacing the armour class bonus they normally give. Applies to everyone."
  ammobox.number:

    label: Notification box number
    gated-by:
      id: fo2tweaks.main.ammobox
      is:
        - 1
    help: "Which of the interface's boxes carries the text. Leave it alone unless you know what this is."
  ammobox.color:

description: "A collection of convenience tweaks, common-sense changes, and cheats for Fallout 2."

homepage: "https://bgforge.net/docs/fallout/fo2tweaks/"

settings:
  main.worldmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: W
    label: World map hotkey
    help: Opens the world map at any moment. A key name rather than a scancode; 0 disables it.
  main.townmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: "Y"
    label: Town map hotkey
    help: Opens the town map at any moment. 0 or T keeps the vanilla T key.
  main.no_scope_penalty:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: No close range penalty for scoped weapons
    help: "Covers the scoped hunting rifle, and the Bozar and sniper rifle where EcCo is installed. Affected weapons are listed in the no_scope_penalty section of the ini."
  main.improved_grenades:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Improved grenades
    help: "Grenades ignore the target's armour class and can be thrown into empty hexes. Also covers flares, explosive rockets and EcCo's grenade launchers."
  main.molotov_fire:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Molotov cocktails do fire damage
    help: "Fire damage instead of explosive, with the burning death animation."
  main.max_knockback:
    kind: int
    min: -1
    unit: hexes
    sentinels:
      "-1": Unlimited (vanilla)
      "0": No knockback
    default: -1
    label: Limit knockback distance
    help: Applies to all weapons and explosives.
  main.trunk_space:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Bottomless car trunk
  main.autodoors:
    kind: choice
    options:
      - value: 0
        label: "Off"
      - value: 1
        label: Open
      - value: 2
        label: Open and close
    default: 1
    label: Automatic doors
    help: "Outside combat, walk through unlocked doors without opening them first, the way NPCs do."
  main.carry_weight:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Unlimited carry weight
    help: The Chosen One carries up to 99999 regardless of Strength.
  main.level5:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Level 5 after the Temple of Trials
    help: Grants 9500 XP on completing the temple.
  main.ammobox:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Show ammo type in combat
    help: The current ammo type is displayed in a notification box.
  main.modoc_brahmin:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Modoc brahmin on your team
    help: Stops party members wiping out the brahmin during the Modoc quest.
  main.healing_revision:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Healing revision
    help: "Reworks Doctor and First Aid - Doctor's effectiveness scales with First Aid, each is usable once a day per patient, the amount healed follows skill level, and healing applies automatically while resting and travelling."
  main.hp_over_head:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Show HP over head
    help: "In combat, for the player, party and nearby enemies. Updates can lag, and it interferes with combat floats."
  main.damage_mod:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Damage mod
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.DamageFormula
      is:
        - 0
    help: "Reworks firearm damage so DR mod multiplies DR and DT and sets the damage multiplier, which makes AP ammo worth carrying. Built for vanilla stats; mods that rebalance ammo, such as YAAM or F2WR, will not combine well."
  main.highlighting:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Expanded highlighting
    help: "Replaces sfall's own highlighting mod. Set Key=0 in the Highlighting section of sfall-mods.ini when using this."
  main.auto_reload:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Reload after combat
    help: Both weapons are reloaded once combat ends.
  main.party_level_match:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Party level match
    help: "Companions level up to match the player's experience rather than staying behind. Covers vanilla and Restoration Project companions."
  main.unlimited_party:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: No charisma limit on party size
    help: Removes the charisma check when an NPC joins. Karma and quest checks still apply.
  main.keymap:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Remap hotkeys
    help: "Applies the remapping in the keymap section of mods/fo2tweaks.ini, which by default puts quick save on F5, quick load on F8, load game on F9, and centre on the player on J."
  main.min_light_level:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    max: 100
    unit: "%"
    sentinels:
      "0": "Off"
    default: 0
    label: Minimum light level
    help: "Map light never falls below this, for Restoration Project maps dark enough to be a strain. 49 is the recommended value."
  main.speedup:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: General game speedup
    help: "Writes faster values into the game's config files - skipped movies, shorter fades, quicker equip animation. It takes effect after loading a save and relaunching, and turning it off later does not put the old values back."
  main.run_speed:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Increased run speed
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.UseFileSystemOverride
      is:
        - 1
    help: Removes the run speed penalty armour carries and lets slower companions keep up. The run_speed section chooses which of them it covers.
  main.no_drop_items_on_death:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: "Don't drop items on death"

  main.improved_grenades:
    kind: bool
    default: 1

    help: "Grenades ignore the target's armour class and can be thrown into empty hexes. Also covers flares, explosive rockets and EcCo's grenade launchers."
  main.molotov_fire:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Molotov cocktails do fire damage
    help: "Fire damage instead of explosive, with the burning death animation."
  main.max_knockback:
    kind: int
    min: -1
    unit: hexes
    sentinels:
      "-1": Unlimited (vanilla)
      "0": No knockback

    help: Applies to all weapons and explosives.

    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Bottomless car trunk

    kind: choice
    options:

    label: Automatic doors
    help: "Outside combat, walk through unlocked doors without opening them first, the way NPCs do."

  main.modoc_brahmin:

  main.healing_revision:
    kind: bool

    label: Healing revision
    help: "Reworks Doctor and First Aid - Doctor's effectiveness scales with First Aid, each is usable once a day per patient, the amount healed follows skill level, and healing applies automatically while resting and travelling."
  main.hp_over_head:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Show HP over head
    help: "In combat, for the player, party and nearby enemies. Updates can lag, and it interferes with combat floats."
  main.damage_mod:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Damage mod
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.DamageFormula
      is:
        - 0
    help: "Reworks firearm damage so DR mod multiplies DR and DT and sets the damage multiplier, which makes AP ammo worth carrying. Built for vanilla stats; mods that rebalance ammo, such as YAAM or F2WR, will not combine well."
  main.highlighting:
    kind: bool
    default: 1

    help: "Replaces sfall's own highlighting mod. Set Key=0 in the Highlighting section of sfall-mods.ini when using this."
  main.auto_reload:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Reload after combat
    help: Both weapons are reloaded once combat ends.
  main.party_level_match:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Party level match
    help: "Companions level up to match the player's experience rather than staying behind. Covers vanilla and Restoration Project companions."
  main.unlimited_party:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: No charisma limit on party size
    help: Removes the charisma check when an NPC joins. Karma and quest checks still apply.
  main.keymap:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Remap hotkeys
    help: "Applies the remapping in the keymap section of mods/fo2tweaks.ini, which by default puts quick save on F5, quick load on F8, load game on F9, and centre on the player on J."
  main.min_light_level:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    max: 100
    unit: "%"
    sentinels:
      "0": "Off"
    default: 0
    label: Minimum light level
    help: "Map light never falls below this, for Restoration Project maps dark enough to be a strain. 49 is the recommended value."
  main.speedup:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: General game speedup
    help: "Writes faster values into the game's config files - skipped movies, shorter fades, quicker equip animation. It takes effect after loading a save and relaunching, and turning it off later does not put the old values back."
  main.run_speed:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Increased run speed
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.UseFileSystemOverride
      is:
        - 1
    help: Removes the run speed penalty armour carries and lets slower companions keep up. The run_speed section chooses which of them it covers.
  main.no_drop_items_on_death:

    default: 1

  main.healing_revision:

    help: "Reworks Doctor and First Aid - Doctor's effectiveness scales with First Aid, each is usable once a day per patient, the amount healed follows skill level, and healing applies automatically while resting and travelling."
  main.hp_over_head:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Show HP over head

  main.damage_mod:
    kind: bool
    default: 1

    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.DamageFormula

    help: "Reworks firearm damage so DR mod multiplies DR and DT and sets the damage multiplier, which makes AP ammo worth carrying. Built for vanilla stats; mods that rebalance ammo, such as YAAM or F2WR, will not combine well."

    help: Both weapons are reloaded once combat ends.
  main.party_level_match:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Party level match
    help: "Companions level up to match the player's experience rather than staying behind. Covers vanilla and Restoration Project companions."
  main.unlimited_party:

    help: Removes the charisma check when an NPC joins. Karma and quest checks still apply.
  main.keymap:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Remap hotkeys
    help: "Applies the remapping in the keymap section of mods/fo2tweaks.ini, which by default puts quick save on F5, quick load on F8, load game on F9, and centre on the player on J."

    kind: bool
    default: 0

    help: "Writes faster values into the game's config files - skipped movies, shorter fades, quicker equip animation. It takes effect after loading a save and relaunching, and turning it off later does not put the old values back."
  main.run_speed:
